description: Quantizer that builds its set of target pitches from a reference melody it has heard, weighting them by how often each pitch occurs rather than following a chosen scale

params.text: Sets how many target pitches incoming notes are quantized to, 1 to 12; at 1 only one pitch ever comes out, and at 12 the module quantizes chromatically
Biases the weighting towards high pitches turned clockwise and low pitches turned anticlockwise, five times the weight at one end against a fifth at the other; centred it applies no bias
Biases the weighting towards pitches held for long gates turned clockwise and short gates turned anticlockwise, five times the weight against a fifth; centred it applies no bias
Sets where the active region of the data table starts, counted in events back from the newest, so quantizing can follow earlier pitches; a red light comes on when that region is empty
Sets how many of the stored reference events are used to work out the weighting, 4 to 240; low values follow the reference closely, high values smooth it out
Erases every pitch event in the data table and turns FREEZE off
Stops new reference events being written into the data table; quantizing carries on from what is already stored, and those stored events are saved with the patch
Turns off the statistical weighting and quantizes chromatically, to twelve-tone equal temperament
Holds the output pitch until the next rising edge at the GATE input, so the pitch does not jump when the reference changes; it applies to the CHORD output as well
Sets how many notes the CHORD output carries, 1 to 5, taking the highest weighted pitches
Three settings: LAST weighs the most recent pitch interval at the CV input, MOST weighs the most frequent interval in the active region, and OFF weighs neither

inputs.text: The monophonic pitch to be quantized
Gate for the pitch being quantized; it marks each note event and triggers the sample and hold
Pitch of the reference performance, recorded into the data table
Gate for the reference pitch; each rising edge stores one event with its pitch, octave, duration and interval
A trigger here clears the data table and turns FREEZE off
Added to the PITCHES knob, at 1.1 pitches per volt
Added to the PERSIST knob; 10V adds the full 240 events
Added to the OFFSET knob; 10V adds the full 240 events
Added to the OCTAVE knob; 5V covers its whole range
Added to the DURATION knob; 5V covers its whole range

outputs.text: A copy of the gate at the GATE input
Polyphonic pitch output carrying the highest weighted target pitches, as many of them as CHORD is set to

notes: the warning light beside the module name comes on when the active region of the data table is empty, and when all twelve notes are in use
the module quantizes to pitches it has heard: patch a reference melody's pitch and gate into REF CV and REF GATE. While the active region of the data table is empty the pitch output is held.
menu: Reset of data table — chooses what RESET does: None only releases FREEZE, Clear all (default) erases every stored event, and Clear with priming erases it then restores the four newest events
Skip repeats of same ref note — stores a run of identical reference pitches as a single event
Copy weights for ProbKey — puts the twelve note weights on the clipboard in the form that Prob-Key's Paste weights from Adaptive Quantizer reads
